name_zh: 埃塞俄比亚·海尔·塞拉西：皇帝现代化与非洲联盟拉斯塔神性
name_en: Ethiopia Haile Selassie: Emperor Modernization & African Union Rastafari Divinity
description_zh: 海尔·塞拉西 (1892-1975) 埃塞俄比亚皇帝 (1930-1974)，抵抗意大利入侵流亡英国回国，推动非洲统一组织成立亚的斯亚贝巴总部，拉斯塔法里运动视为黑人弥赛亚，1974年军变下台。
description_en: Haile Selassie (1892-1975) Ethiopia Emperor (1930-1974), resisted Italian invasion exiled UK returned, promoted OAU founding Addis Ababa headquarters, Rastafari movement views as Black Messiah, 1974 coup overthrown.
reason_zh: 海尔·塞拉西代表非洲唯一未被殖民国家皇帝如何通过现代化与泛非外交构建地区领袖地位，展示了拉斯塔法里运动如何将埃塞俄比亚皇帝神圣化为黑人解放象征，其非盟总部遗产永存。
reason_en: Selassie represents how African only uncolonized nation Emperor built regional leadership through modernization and Pan-African diplomacy, demonstrating how Rastafari movement sacralized Ethiopian Emperor as Black liberation symbol, his AU headquarters legacy endures.
steps_zh: 研究海尔早年摄政王与1930年加冕皇帝
分析1935意大利入侵流亡日内瓦国联演说
探讨1963非洲统一组织成立亚迪斯亚贝巴总部
评估拉斯塔法里运动弥赛亚崇拜与雷鬼音乐传播
总结皇帝现代化非洲联盟拉斯塔神性对非洲一体化的奠基遗产
steps_en: Study Selassie early regent and 1930 coronation Emperor
Analyze 1935 Italian invasion exile Geneva League of Nations speech
Explore 1963 OAU founding Addis Ababa headquarters
Evaluate Rastafari Messiah worship and reggae music dissemination
Summarize Emperor modernization African Union Rastafari divinity foundational legacy for African integration
expected_zh: 理解唯一未殖民非洲国家如何通过皇帝外交确立泛非领导地位，掌握宗教运动如何跨越国界重塑政治人物神圣性，评估海尔遗产对非盟与全球黑人解放运动的双重贡献。
expected_en: Understand how only uncolonized African nation established Pan-African leadership through Emperor diplomacy, grasp how religious movement transcends borders resacralizing political figure, evaluate Selassie dual contribution for AU and global Black liberation movement.
case_zh: 1930 加冕；1935 流亡；1963 非盟；1974 军变。皇帝现代化非盟拉斯塔范式永存。
case_en: 1930 coronation; 1935 exile; 1963 OAU; 1974 coup. Emperor modernization AU Rastafari paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: OAU founder; Rastafari Messiah; anti-colonial resistance; African unity
